summary: Fase 53 frontend testing completed. Core conversion flow (lead → customer) works correctly. Contract panel displays properly with correct empty state handling ('Belum diisi' instead of 'Rp 0'). Costs dialog and contract activation functional. RBAC working as expected. Session expiration issue noted but does not block functionality.

integration_issues.issue: Login sessions expire frequently during testing (as noted in review request). Users need to re-login multiple times during extended use. This is a known issue mentioned in the review request.
integration_issues.note: This was already reported in previous iteration (iteration_84) and is a known issue. Does not block core functionality but affects user experience.

integration_issues.issue: FRONTEND-6 could not be fully tested - no deals found in the list during testing. This may be because all test deals were converted to customers or deals are filtered by status.
integration_issues.note: Not a bug - just no test data available. The 'Jadikan Pembeli' button code exists in DealsListTab.js and should work when booked deals without contracts are present.

notes: Backend was already proven working via POC (66 PASS / 0 FAIL) as stated in review request, so backend testing was skipped per instructions.
Session expiration issue is a known issue from previous iteration (iteration_84) and does not block core functionality.
FRONTEND-6 (deals list conversion button) could not be fully tested due to no test data, but code review confirms the button exists in DealsListTab.js.
All critical user flows work correctly: lead → reservation → booking → customer conversion → contract creation → costs filling → contract activation.
Empty component handling is correct: shows 'Belum diisi (bukan nol)' instead of 'Rp 0'.
RBAC is working correctly: finance can see costs but not legal buttons, sales can access their leads.
No red error screens found on any tested pages.
